body.compose:
# CR_TEST_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: explicit local PoC approval is required before deployment.
name: cr-demo-infra-eng-83d2e658
x-cr-test-approval-required: 'POST /api/deploy/{id}/up with {"test_approved": true}'
services:
  attacker:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-83d2e658-attacker
    networks:
    - dmz
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: alpine:3.22@sha256:49340b346798875b5592e5d420241f2f9cfba5f47e62ebb1446a1b34734e898f
    user: 65532:65532
    command:
    - sh
    - -c
    - sleep 2147483647
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
    depends_on:
      portal:
        condition: service_healthy
  portal:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-83d2e658-portal
    networks:
    - dmz
    - data
    read_only: false
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: vulhub/struts2:2.3.30@sha256:b992e080d8e5ad332bf526ae26124d28f56ca4fc9e0eaa91510dbee9870eb2c8
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -fsS
      - -o
      - /dev/null
      - http://127.0.0.1:8080/
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 60s
    mem_limit: 1g
    cpus: 2.0
    pids_limit: 512
    depends_on:
      db-dispute:
        condition: service_healthy
      db-other-1:
        condition: service_healthy
      db-other-2:
        condition: service_healthy
  db-dispute:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-83d2e658-db-dispute
    networks:
    - data
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /var/lib/mysql:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=768m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0700
    - /var/run/mysqld:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=8m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0755
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: mysql:8.0.46@sha256:7dcddc01f13bab2f15cde676d44d01f61fc9f99fe7785e86196dfc07d358ae2b
    user: 999:999
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${CR_DB_PASSWORD:?set at deploy time}
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${CR_DB_PASSWORD:?set at deploy time}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: app
      MYSQL_USER: app
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - mysqladmin
      - ping
      - -h
      - 127.0.0.1
      - --protocol=tcp
      - --silent
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 20s
    mem_limit: 1g
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
  db-other-1:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-83d2e658-db-other-1
    networks:
    - data
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /var/lib/postgresql/data:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=256m,uid=70,gid=70,mode=0700
    - /var/run/postgresql:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m,uid=70,gid=70,mode=0700
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: postgres:16.16-alpine3.23@sha256:48340c4811085e083751cab526e533662da19585c1e6942a28b9c48ce7fcb8b2
    user: 70:70
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${CR_PG_PASSWORD:?set at deploy time}
      POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: ${CR_PG_AUTH_METHOD:-trust}
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - pg_isready
      - -h
      - 127.0.0.1
      - -p
      - '5432'
      - -U
      - postgres
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 5s
    mem_limit: 512m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
  db-other-2:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-83d2e658-db-other-2
    networks:
    - data
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /var/lib/mysql:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=512m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0700
    - /run/mysqld:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=8m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0755
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: mariadb:11.4.13@sha256:5e73baf8179b29f115101bb102763a47a017361f3e9792daccba6646c3ab1532
    user: 999:999
    environment:
      MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${CR_DB_PASSWORD:?set at deploy time}
      MARIADB_PASSWORD: ${CR_DB_PASSWORD:?set at deploy time}
      MARIADB_DATABASE: app
      MARIADB_USER: app
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - mariadb-admin
      - ping
      - -h
      - 127.0.0.1
      - --protocol=tcp
      - --silent
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 15s
    mem_limit: 768m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
networks:
  data:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-83d2e658-data
    internal: true
  dmz:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-83d2e658-dmz
    internal: true

checks.expected: 容器狀態為執行中
checks.observed: 容器狀態=running，健康狀態=沒有健康狀態資料

checks.name: portal 服務執行狀態
checks.expected: 容器狀態為執行中

checks.expected: 容器狀態為執行中

checks.expected: 容器狀態為執行中

checks.expected: 容器狀態為執行中

checks.name: attacker 可連線至 portal:8080
checks.expected: 對宣告服務建立一條 TCP 連線 portal:8080

checks.name: attacker 完成至 portal 的宣告路徑
checks.expected: 宣告的 TCP 路徑及其無害服務行為皆通過
checks.observed: 已連線（已連線（CONNECTED））; 目標服務沒有適用的無害行為探測

checks.name: portal 可連線至 db-dispute:3306
checks.expected: 對宣告服務建立一條 TCP 連線 db-dispute:3306

checks.expected: 宣告的 TCP 路徑及其無害服務行為皆通過
checks.observed: 已連線（已連線（CONNECTED））; 目標服務沒有適用的無害行為探測

checks.name: portal 可連線至 db-other-1:5432
checks.expected: 對宣告服務建立一條 TCP 連線 db-other-1:5432

checks.name: db-other-1 回傳無害服務回應
checks.expected: pg_isready 回報可接受連線

checks.name: portal 完成至 db-other-1 的宣告路徑
checks.expected: 宣告的 TCP 路徑及其無害服務行為皆通過
checks.observed: 已連線（已連線（CONNECTED））; 127.0.0.1:5432 - 正在接受連線

checks.expected: 對宣告服務建立一條 TCP 連線 db-other-2:3306

checks.name: portal 完成至 db-other-2 的宣告路徑
checks.expected: 宣告的 TCP 路徑及其無害服務行為皆通過
checks.observed: 已連線（已連線（CONNECTED））; 目標服務沒有適用的無害行為探測

checks.name: attacker 無法連線至 db-dispute:3306
checks.expected: TCP 連線來源 attacker to db-dispute:3306 遭封鎖
checks.observed: probed db-dispute=172.29.0.3:3306 from attacker; 連線遭拒（BLOCKED:）：OSError:[Errno 101] Network is unreachable

checks.name: attacker 無法連線至 db-other-1:5432
checks.expected: TCP 連線來源 attacker to db-other-1:5432 遭封鎖
checks.observed: probed db-other-1=172.29.0.4:5432 from attacker; 連線遭拒（BLOCKED:）：OSError:[Errno 101] Network is unreachable

fidelity.summary: 佐證涵蓋容器狀態、指定元件版本、允許與封鎖的 TCP 路徑及無害服務回應。沒有動作專屬佐證時，不會宣稱已重現情境動作。
